chapter_name: Shabd Bhandar: Paryayvachi, Vilom, Muhavare, Aur Lokoktiyan (Vocabulary: Synonyms, Antonyms, Idioms, and Proverbs)
learning_objective: 🎯 By the end of this chapter, you will expand your word treasure chest, learning colorful idioms and powerful synonyms to make your Hindi sound rich and impressive!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Why always say 'Paani' (Water) when you can say 'Jal' or 'Neer'? Paryayvachi are words that look different but mean the exact same thing. They make your writing beautiful and avoid boring repetition! Examples: Sun (सूर्य, रवि, दिनकर), Flower (फूल, पुष्प, सुमन).

Vilom means reverse or opposite. They are pairs of words that represent totally opposite ideas! Examples: Day/Night (दिन/रात), Truth/Lie (सच/झूठ), Profit/Loss (लाभ/हानि). Tip: If the word is a Tatsam (Sanskrit) word, its opposite must also be a Tatsam word (like अंधकार/प्रकाश).

'Anekarthi' means one word, many meanings. The word 'तीर' (Teer) can mean an Arrow AND a River bank! 'Shruti Sam Bhinnarthak' are words that *sound* the same but are spelled slightly differently and mean different things. Example: 'दिन' (Day) vs. 'दीन' (Poor).

Idioms are phrases that don't mean what they literally say! If someone says 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना' (To become nine two eleven), they aren't doing math; it's a secret code for 'running away'! Muhavare are always used *inside* sentences to make the language spicy.

Lokokti means 'Voice of the people' (Proverbs). Unlike Muhavare, these are full, complete sentences that contain a life lesson or truth, often used at the end of a story. Example: 'अधजल गगरी छलकत जाए' (A half-filled pot spills water) meaning: A person with little knowledge shows off the most!

fun_activity.title: 👁️ The 'Body Parts Idiom' Game
fun_activity.instructions: Hindi has dozens of 'Muhavare' based on body parts! Write down one idiom using the word 'आँख' (Eye) and one using the word 'कान' (Ear). Then write a sentence for each showing its hidden meaning! (Hint: Look up 'आँखों का तारा').

quick_recap: ⭐ Paryayvachi words provide different spelling options for the exact same meaning.
⭐ Vilom words represent opposite concepts and should match the origin of the original word.
⭐ Shruti Sam Bhinnarthak are words that sound similar but have different spellings and meanings.
⭐ Muhavare (Idioms) are phrases with special, non-literal meanings used within sentences.
⭐ Lokoktiyan (Proverbs) are complete sentences that act as standalone moral lessons or observations.
